items.t: Quasar: Completion queue wraparound uses the wrong address basis
ccl: reduce_scatter_minimal_async line-topology perf tests time out at 300 s on Blackhole (comp_pcc takes 32-44 s per 10.5M-element output, x10 traced iterations)
ttnn.cbrt (FLOAT32) is wrong for every subnormal input, returning 0 or a value up to 6306x low: the magic-constant seed assumes a normal exponent field and SFPMAD flushes the operand
ttnn.lgamma is 474,555 fp32 ULP off at x=0.6 and 9% wrong near x=0.5: Stirling's asymptotic series is evaluated at the input with no argument shift, and the error is an even function of (x-0.5)

ttnn.add/subtract/multiply silently return wrong values at rank >= 7 when an operand is broadcast at dim -6: binary_ng collapses dims -6 and outward into one counter, and four of six tiles read past the end of the operand
ttnn.rms_norm on a rank-0 tensor computes x / |x|: epsilon is dropped, x = 0 gives NaN and every |x| < sqrt(eps) gives ±1
ttnn.argmax: FLOAT32 never selects a NaN and BFLOAT16 lets a later +0 beat an earlier -0, so the two dtypes return different indices and both differ from torch
ttnn.xlogy(0, y) returns NaN for y <= 0 where the convention is 0: the NaN guard inspects only the second operand
ttnn.xlogy_bw and ttnn.addcdiv_bw hard-code the sign of the infinity at a zero divisor and skip the NaN case
ttnn.div and div_no_nan return NaN for every subnormal denominator; div(x,x) is NaN instead of 1
ttnn.hardswish_bw takes the wrong branch at exactly x = ±3 and uses 0.3333 for 1/3
ttnn.atanh_bw returns NaN for every element whose upstream gradient is exactly zero
ttnn.rpow_bw computes the gradient of x**base instead of base**x; NaN for every negative input
Quasar: two DFBs chained through a Tensix stage silently return wrong data when a DM endpoint outnumbers the Tensix side
Quasar: gtz/gez/ltz/lez return 1 for NaN — the comparison-to-zero predicate has no inf term, which Wormhole and Blackhole both carry
